    assert allow() is True
    assert allow() is True

    clock.set(10.0)

def test_sliding_window_prunes_only_expired_calls(clock):
    allow = rate_limiter(max_calls=3, period_seconds=10.0)

    assert allow() is True  # t=0

    assert allow() is True  # t=1
    clock.set(2.0)
    assert allow() is True  # t=2

    clock.set(9.999)
    assert allow() is False  # all 3 calls are still inside the window

    clock.set(10.0)
    assert allow() is True  # t=0 expired, t=1 and t=2 remain

    assert allow() is False  # now back at max calls in the window
